title: visible with keyboard
rule: Keep the field visible in both orientations when the keyboard is displayed.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields

pass_when: Focused field stays visible with the on-screen keyboard in portrait and landscape.
fail_when: Keyboard covers the field in an orientation so the value cannot be seen.
overview: Keep the focused field visible with the keyboard in both orientations.
apply_when: Mobile text entry with on-screen keyboard in portrait or landscape.
not_when: Hard-keyboard or desktop contexts without an on-screen keyboard.
agent_hint: Scroll or layout so the focused field stays visible above the keyboard.
description: Keep the field visible in both orientations when the keyboard is displayed. Pass when the focused field stays visible with the on-screen keyboard in portrait and landscape; fail when the keyboard covers the field in an orientation so the value cannot be seen. Users must see what they type while the soft keyboard is up.
